basic_info.description: Discover this lovely and spacious one-bedroom, one-bathroom quiet rear condo, perfectly situated in an exclusive six-unit building on a tranquil stretch of Gough and Green. This inviting condo features a generously sized living room and a formal dining area with elegant pocket doors, making it ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. The bedroom features a large walk-in closet with access to the bathroom.  The kitchen provides ample cabinet storage, while the unit showcases stunning details such as coved ceilings, crown moldings, and beautiful mahogany inlaid hardwood floors. Step outside to enjoy the shared backyard or the roof deck, complete with panoramic Bay views. Additional highlights include shared laundry facilities for your convenience and one car parking. Located just steps from the picturesque Allyne Park and only a block from the vibrant Union Street, you'll have easy access to a wealth of shops, cafes, gyms, yoga studios, and more. Plus, convenient MUNI bus transportation nearby.  Don't miss this incredible opportunity to make this charming condominium your new home!
